_comment: Registry of functions that apply quest reactions SYNCHRONOUSLY, outside the bounded worker queue.
The 2026-07-15 performance pass made reaction delivery bounded: ApplyQuestReaction is ingress-only
(snapshot -> FIFO -> return) and PDV_QuestReactionWorker drains QUEST_REACTION_QUEUE_CELLS_PER_TICK
applied cells per 0.1s slice. Every check in pdv_quest_reaction_performance_audit.mjs anchored on that
queue and reasoned forward, so a function calling ApplyDeityReaction directly in a straight line was
structurally invisible to the gate -- the same 'audit anchored on one side' shape as the curated-signal
Rules enforced by the audit's fanout.* checks:
- A function applying more than 'budget' reactions synchronously MUST be listed here, or FAIL.
- Listed but now applying MORE than its maxApplications = FAIL (someone grew a burst silently).
- Listed but no longer a fan-out (removed, queued, or trimmed under budget) = FAIL (anti-rot;
delete the line when you fix the function).
Listing something here is a documented, owner-accepted exception -- not a licence to grow it.
Burn entries down by routing the work through the queue or trimming the roster.

HandlePaarthurnaxKill.reason: The Paarthurnax kill/spare choice is a hand-rolled fork, not a matrix cell, because the spare branch never advances a quest stage and the kill can happen outside the quest path. There is no quest|stage key to enqueue against.
HandlePaarthurnaxKill.whyAccepted: Owner decision 2026-07-16. Latched once per save (PDV.Paarthurnax.KillSeen), fires on a dragon kill where a brief hitch is masked, and the roster is never fully applied in practice: ApplyDeityReaction returns early on the reachability check, so an out-of-roster face costs a cheap lookup rather than an application. A Khajiit reaches Khenarthi plus the four Daedric paths and drops the rest.

HandlePaarthurnaxSpare.reason: Same fork as HandlePaarthurnaxKill; the spare branch is latched via PDV.Paarthurnax.SpareSeen and fires from the main-quest closeout with Paarthurnax alive.
HandlePaarthurnaxSpare.whyAccepted: Owner decision 2026-07-16. Same reachability argument as the kill fork.

EvaluateQuestMetaFaucets.reason: DEAD CODE: zero callers anywhere in live-source. Superseded by ProcessQueuedQuestReactionMetaSlice, which does the same meta-faucet work inside the bounded queue slice.
EvaluateQuestMetaFaucets.whyAccepted: Not accepted -- registered only so the gate is honest about what exists. It cannot cost runtime today (nothing calls it), but it is a landmine: a future caller would reintroduce an 8-application synchronous burst. Remove the function and delete this entry; the anti-rot check will confirm.
